source_quote: The Manufacturing and Automation Engineering (MAE) minor aims to broaden
entity: Minor in Manufacturing and Automation Engineering
answer: The Manufacturing and Automation Engineering (MAE) minor broadens knowledge of automation techniques and manufacturing methods (decision-making, materials, processes, quality control, system integration) and prepares students for graduate study in manufacturing, industrial and automation engineering.

answer: MAE students complete at least 18 credits; with timely advising they may also do their Co-op or BE project in manufacturing and automation engineering, though it is not required.

source_quote: Automate and control complex industrial equipment and processes
entity: Minor in Manufacturing and Automation Engineering
answer: MAE graduates can solve practical automation and manufacturing problems, use modern CAD/CAM/CAE tools, automate and control industrial equipment and processes, and make decisions based on professional and ethical behavior.

source_quote: This minor allows MAE holders to start careers in supply chain management, product
entity: Minor in Manufacturing and Automation Engineering
answer: MAE holders can work in supply chain management, product design and development, quality control and assurance, production lines, cost engineering, and design, automation and operation of integrated systems.

source_quote: While most relevant to mechanical and mechatronics engineering students, this minor is
entity: Minor in Manufacturing and Automation Engineering
answer: The MAE minor targets mechanical and mechatronics students but is open to RHU BS/BE students in civil, electrical, CCE and biomedical engineering (and case by case to outside graduates). It requires the Minor Declaration Form, approval of the student's college dean, a minor CGPA of at least 70%, and 18 credits, at least 3 of which are exclusive to the minor.

source_quote: A description of the courses from which a student should select 18 credits is given below:
entity: Minor in Manufacturing and Automation Engineering
answer: MAE minor students select 18 credits from MECA 515 Modern Control Systems, MECA 541 CAD/CAM/CAE, MECA 542 Industrial and Manufacturing Control, MECA 545 Integrated Automation Lab, MECA 586 Mechatronics Drives, MECH 422 Manufacturing Processes, MECH 470 Product Design and Development, MECH 527 Modern Material Science, MECH 570 Digital Manufacturing, and MECH 571 Optimization in Engineering Design.

answer: In the MAE minor section, MECH 422 Manufacturing Processes, 3(3,0), is described as covering materials, tolerances, machining, casting, sheet metal forming, injection molding, thermoforming, plastics, process performance, quality, sustainability and additive manufacturing, with a project. Prerequisite: MECH 320.
review_note: This description differs from the MECH 422 description in the Mechanical section (p.389), which covers steelmaking, rolling, forging, welding and NDT.
